facts.text: The resort is set in Western Virginia in the Allegheny Mountains.
facts.excerpt: The Omni Homestead Resort & Spa is nestled in Western Virginia and the Allegheny Mountains and is known for its southern hospitality and charm.

facts.text: The resort has been designated a National Historic Landmark and makes up most of the town of Hot Springs, Virginia.
facts.excerpt: Our resort has been designated a National Historic Landmark and makes up most of the city of Hot Springs, Virginia.

facts.text: Thomas Bullitt built the first hotel on the site of the resort in 1766.
facts.excerpt: Andrew Lewis was an early partner of Thomas Bullitt, who procured 300 acres including the hot springs and built the first hotel in 1766 on the site of The Omni Homestead Resort & Spa.

facts.text: The resort has hosted 24 U.S. presidents.
facts.excerpt: As America's first resort, The Omni Homestead Resort & Spa has been a premier destination delighting travelers for over 250 years, even hosting 24 U.S. presidents.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says 23 presidents have visited the property.
facts.excerpt: By the late 1800s, the resort was a favorite destination for US Presidents (23 presidents have visited the property)

facts.text: The current resort dates to 1902, when M.E. Ingalls redeveloped the grounds after a fire destroyed the original structure.
facts.excerpt: The current iteration of the resort, though, harkens back to 1902, when M.E. Ingalls redeveloped the grounds after a fire destroyed the initial structure.

facts.text: A renovation restored the resort's historic character, from the Great Hall to the guest rooms and the bathhouses at the Warm Springs Pools.
facts.excerpt: A $170 million renovation restored the historic character to our Allegheny Mountain resort in Virginia, from the Great Hall to the guest rooms and the bathhouses at the iconic Warm Springs Pools.

facts.text: The 2023 renovations let more sunlight fall on the original 1902 stained glass in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: more sunlight bounces off the original 1902 stained glass in the lobby

facts.text: In the Great Hall, a custom pink carpet nods to the flora and fauna of the surrounding Allegheny Mountains.
facts.excerpt: In the Great Hall a custom-designed carpet boasts in pink with a nod to the flora and fauna of the Allegheny Mountains surrounding

facts.text: The original octagonal stone bathing basin at the Warm Springs Pools was built in 1761, making it the first spa structure in America.
facts.excerpt: The original octagonal stone basin that held the water for bathing was built in 1761, establishing it as the first spa structure in America.

facts.text: The Ladies' Bathhouse at the Warm Springs Pools was built in the mid-1870s.
facts.excerpt: A second structure, the Ladies’ Bathhouse, was built in the mid-1870s.

facts.text: The Warm Springs Pools stay at 98-99 degrees year-round.
facts.excerpt: Flowing at an astounding rate of 1,700,000 gallons per day, the waters stay at a soothing 98-99 degrees, creating the perfect environment for relaxation.

facts.text: The Warm Springs Pools are in Warm Springs, Virginia, about five miles from the resort.
facts.excerpt: The Warm Springs Pools are located at 11 Bath Street, Warm Springs, Virginia, approximately five miles from the resort.

facts.text: The signature Warm Springs experience gives 50 minutes of exclusive access to the Gentlemen's or Ladies' Bathhouse, both dating to the 19th century.
facts.excerpt: Your session includes 50 minutes of exclusive access to either the Gentlemen’s or Ladies’ Bathhouse, each dating back to the 19th century.

facts.text: The private soak includes chilled prosecco and chocolate-covered strawberries under lantern light.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy chilled prosecco and chocolate-covered strawberries under lantern light while you luxuriate in these mineral rich, geothermal springs.

facts.text: The private Warm Springs soak is only for registered hotel guests aged 16 and over.
facts.excerpt: Must be a registered hotel guest to book this experience. Available for 1–2 participants. Additional guests are welcome for a fee. Attendees must be age 16+.

facts.text: Reservations are required at the Warm Springs Pools.
facts.excerpt: Reservations are required and may be made by calling (540) 839-3860.

facts.text: The resort has a two-acre water park.
facts.excerpt: Our one-of-a-kind Hot Springs resort features a two-acre water park and top-ranked golf courses

facts.text: The golf includes the nation's oldest first tee in continuous use.
facts.excerpt: including the nation’s oldest first tee in continuous use

facts.text: The resort has two golf courses, The Cascades and The Old Course.
facts.excerpt: Tee off amid the beauty of the Allegheny Mountains on two legendary courses, The Cascades and The Old Course

facts.text: The first six holes of the Old Course were built in 1892.
facts.excerpt: the first six holes of the Old Course were built in 1892

facts.text: The Spa has an adults-only Serenity Garden, home to the historic natural hot springs.
facts.excerpt: an adults-only Serenity Garden, home to the historic natural hot springs

facts.text: Spa guests can enjoy a river reflexology walk, poolside cabanas and an outdoor Finnish-style sauna.
facts.excerpt: Here, guests can also enjoy a river reflexology walk, poolside cabanas, and an outdoor Finnish-style sauna.

facts.text: The Spa has the Herbal Cocoon, a Himalayan salt sauna.
facts.excerpt: chill-out to the max in the Herbal Cocoon, a Himalayan salt sauna

facts.text: Premier rooms have views of the Allegheny Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Cozy and scenic, Premier rooms are a tranquil retreat featuring premium amenities and stunning views of the Allegheny Mountains, accommodating up to 5 guests.

facts.text: Rooms are furnished in traditional Virginia style with framed prints.
facts.excerpt:
Decked out in traditional
Virginia
style furnishing and framed prints

facts.text: Outdoor activities include four Har-Tru tennis courts, pickleball, hiking and biking trails, archery, kayaking and fly fishing.
facts.excerpt: Four Har-Tru tennis courts, pickleball, hiking and biking trails, archery, kayaking, fly fishing and more outdoor activities

facts.text: The resort has onsite stables for horseback riding on wooded trails.
facts.excerpt: The resort has onsite stables for guest horseback riding through trails in the wooded forests.

facts.text: Omni shuttles take guests to a trail along Cascades Creek, about 15 minutes away, for guided hikes or fly-fishing.
facts.excerpt: Only around 15 minutes away is a trail along Cascades Creek, and Omni shuttle buses are available for guests to endure a guided, light hike, or fly-fishing experience.

facts.text: The Cascades Creek trail passes 12 cascading waterfalls.
facts.excerpt: Along the way are 12 dreamy, cascading waterfalls.

facts.text: Family activities include an indoor swimming pool, mini bowling, nightly kids' movies at Theater 1923, wagon rides, falconry and lawn games.
facts.excerpt: including an indoor swimming pool, mini bowling, nightly showings of kids’ movies at Theater 1923, wagon rides, falconry, lawn games and more

facts.text: In winter, families can go skiing, snow tubing and ice skating.
facts.excerpt: You can also enjoy seasonal outdoor activities like skiing, snow tubing and ice skating with the family during the winter months.

facts.text: The Presidential Lounge is a speakeasy-style lobby bar with a portrait collection of the resort's presidential guests.
facts.excerpt: While a portrait collection of the resort’s presidential guests caters to quite a fitting name

facts.text: Theater 1923 has a Prohibition-style cocktail bar, and guests can take drinks to their seats for film screenings.
facts.excerpt: Just outside of the Theater is a Prohibition-style cocktail bar, where guests can order a drink to sip on and take to their seats for film screenings or perhaps even a magic show.

facts.text: The surrounding area is so quiet there is not one traffic light, only stop signs.
facts.excerpt: The neighborhood that surrounds The Homestead is charmingly quiet, to the point where there’s not one traffic light, only stop signs.

facts.text: Common flight routes are via Greenbrier Valley Airport, 50 miles away, or Roanoke-Blacksburg Regional Airport, 73 miles away.
facts.excerpt: common routes are to and from the Greenbrier Valley Airport (50 miles away), or Roanoke-Blacksburg Regional Airport (73 miles away)

facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly for dogs only.
facts.excerpt: Yes, The Omni Homestead Resort & Spa is a pet-friendly resort for dogs only.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes a $150 million property-wide renovation.
facts.excerpt: The Omni Homestead just celebrated a grand-reopening with a dramatic $150 million property-wide renovation

facts.text: The official site describes a $170 million renovation.
facts.excerpt: A $170 million renovation restored the historic character to our Allegheny Mountain resort in Virginia
